items.title: Injectivity of Cech H-1 and its identification with torsors trivial along the covering

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that Cech H-1 of a covering injects into the first cohomology group and identifies it with the isomorphism classes of torsors trivial along the covering (statement lines 1415-1429). The proof constructs the inverse map explicitly: it chooses a section of the torsor over each member of the covering using the triviality criterion (proof lines 1432-1436), forms the Cech cocycle measuring the disagreement of those sections on the fibre products, checks that its class is well defined (proof lines 1436-1441), and records that the map so defined is the required inverse (proof lines 1442-1444). The author omits only the verification that the construction is an inverse, a routine tail which is retained verbatim inside the counted span. The claim is H2: one explicit construction.
